title: Nearly 300,000 people sign petition demanding U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra's removal
summary: More than 285,000 people have signed a petition asking the federal government to remove U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra from Canada.

image.caption: U.S. Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra has made several comments supporting U.S. President Donald Trump's position that Canada should become the 51st state. (Keito Newman/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: More than 285,000 people have signed a petition asking the federal government to remove U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra from Canada.
Government will have 45 days to respond after petition is tabled
· Posted: Nov 18, 2026 2:45 PM EST | Last Updated: 12 minutes ago
The petition accuses Hoekstra of making public statements that have undermined Canadian and U.S. relations and says he described the 2025 Canadian federal election campaign as "anti-American."
The petition says Hoekstra accused Canada of interfering in U.S. domestic politics while making repeated statements on Canadian politics "inconsistent with diplomatic protocol."
The petition closes to new signatures on Wednesday and most of those who signed live in Ontario or British Columbia.

items: Tens of thousands of Canadians call for U.S. Ambassador Hoekstra to be expelled

blocks.text: Now that the petition has received more than the mandatory 500 signatures it needed to proceed, former Green Party leader Elizabeth May can present it to the House of Commons.
Once it's presented to the House, the government has 45 calendar days to respond.
Alyssa Wheeler is a reporter with The Canadian Press.
